title: Mixed Conditionals & Mandative Subjunctive Mood
subtitle: CEFR C1–C2 • Cross-Time Counterfactuals & Formal Policy Directives

topics.title: 1. Mixed Conditionals (Past Cause → Present Result)
topics.subtitle: Connecting Unchanged Past Decisions to Current Realities
topics.explanation: Menggabungkan dua zona waktu berbeda dalam satu kalimat pengandaian: kondisi lampau yang tidak terjadi (If + had + Verb-3) yang dampaknya terasa pada kondisi sekarang (would + Verb-1). Dipakai untuk mengevaluasi keputusan masa lalu yang memengaruhi situasi hari ini.
topics.rationale: Dalam kehidupan nyata, penyesalan atau evaluasi strategis sering melintasi batas waktu: 'Seandainya dulu kita melakukan A, sekarang kita pasti berada di posisi B'.

formulas.pattern: If + Subject + had + Verb-3 (Past), Subject + would ('d) + Verb-1 (Now)
If + Subject + hadn't + Verb-3 (Past), Subject + wouldn't + Verb-1 (Now)
Where would + Subject + be now if + Subject + hadn't + Verb-3?

conditionalExamples.positive: If we had documented the API schema earlier, onboarding new engineers would be effortless today.
conditionalExamples.negative: If she hadn't spotted that memory leak last week, our servers wouldn't be running smoothly right now.
conditionalExamples.question: Would we be facing this technical debt today if we had refactored the core earlier?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Klausa 'If' memakai Past Perfect ('had documented' = masa lalu), sedangkan klausa hasil memakai 'would + V1' ('would be' = masa kini).

xrayTokens.nuance: Kejadian masa lalu yang berlawanan dengan fakta
Dampak imajiner pada kondisi hari ini

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Mencampur 'Would Have' Jika Dampaknya Masih Berlaku Sekarang
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Would have + V3' (Third Conditional) dipakai jika hasil maupun syaratnya sama-sama sudah selesai di masa lalu. Jika hasilnya masih berlangsung hari ini, gunakan 'would + V1'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: If I had accepted that job last year, I would have lived in Tokyo right now.
specialExceptions.correctExample: If I had accepted that job last year, I would be living in Tokyo right now.

tipsAndTricks: Kata penanda waktu 'now', 'today', atau 'at the moment' di klausa kedua adalah kunci utama untuk membedakan Mixed Conditional dari Third Conditional.

topics.title: 2. The Mandative Subjunctive (Recommend / Insist / Essential that + Bare V1)
topics.subtitle: Uninflected Base Verbs After Verbs & Adjectives of Urgency
topics.explanation: Setelah kata kerja atau kata sifat yang menyatakan tuntutan, rekomendasi, atau urgensi (recommend, insist, demand, suggest, propose, essential, vital, imperative + that), kata kerja berikutnya wajib berbentuk dasar murni (Bare Infinitive / V1) tanpa '-s', tanpa '-ed', dan memakai 'be' (bukan is/are).
topics.rationale: Bentuk subjunctive menunjukkan bahwa tindakan tersebut adalah sebuah keharusan atau proposal ideal, bukan fakta yang sedang terjadi.

formulas.pattern: S + [recommend / insist / require] + that + Subject + Bare V1 (be / go / submit)
S + [insist / recommend] + that + Subject + NOT + Bare V1 (no 'don't/doesn't'!)
Is it essential that + Subject + be + [Adjective / Past Participle]?

conditionalExamples.positive: The security policy requires that every engineer enable two-factor authentication.
conditionalExamples.negative: I strongly recommend that he not deploy directly to the main branch.
conditionalExamples.question: Is it vital that the server be restarted after updating the kernel?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Perhatikan: 'every engineer enable' (tanpa -s), 'he not deploy' (tanpa doesn't), dan 'the server be' (bukan is).

xrayTokens.nuance: Tetap V1 murni meskipun subjeknya tunggal ('every engineer')
Negasi subjunctive langsung memakai 'not + V1' tanpa auxiliary 'does'

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Menyisipkan 'Does/Don't' dalam Negative Subjunctive
specialExceptions.explanation: Dalam bentuk subjunctive formal, negasi dibentuk hanya dengan kata 'not' sebelum V1.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: The board insisted that the CEO doesn't resign.
specialExceptions.correctExample: The board insisted that the CEO not resign.

tipsAndTricks: Gunakan 'It is essential that [Subject] be [Verb-3]' dalam dokumentasi teknis maupun esai IELTS/TOEFL untuk langsung mendongkrak skor grammatical range ke band 8+.

scenario.interlocutor: Compliance Auditor meninjau klausul akses server
scenario.intent: Menulis aturan wajib menggunakan Mandative Subjunctive standar internasional.

practiceQuiz.question: Kalimat mana yang menggunakan Mandative Subjunctive dengan benar?

options.text: Company policy mandates that every contractor signs an NDA before access is granted.
Company policy mandates that every contractor sign an NDA before access is granted.
Company policy mandates that every contractor to sign an NDA before access is granted.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: Setelah 'mandates that', kata kerja subjek tunggal ('every contractor') tetap berbentuk dasar murni ('sign') tanpa akhiran '-s'.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A memakai bentuk indikatif biasa ('signs'), dan Opsi C keliru menyisipkan 'to'.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Daftar pemicu Subjunctive: suggest, recommend, insist, demand, require, mandate, vital, essential, imperative.
